appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales'. The word 'Additional' is prominent.
Five blue circular markers are plotted, labeled Store 6 through Store 10.
The points form a clear upward-sloping linear trend.
Store 10 is the highest and rightmost point, isolated from the cluster of Stores 6-9.

printed_facts.fact: Label is 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)'. Ticks range from 25 to 75.
Label is 'Sales ($ thousands)'. Ticks range from 50 to 190.
Store 6 is at approx (30, 60). Store 7 is at approx (35, 68). Store 8 is at approx (42, 85). Store 9 is at approx (48, 96). Store 10 is at approx (70, 181).
The chart specifically covers 'Additional Top Stores', implying a subset of the total population.

public_definitions: The task requires reviewing the ad budget dashboard to complete an expansion approval form.
Options include 'Hold and request full-store analysis', 'Approve company-wide budget expansion', or 'Reject budget expansion at this time'.
uncertain: The chart only displays 'Additional Top Stores' (Stores 6-10), so it does not provide data for the entire company or all stores.
There is no explicit policy table defining the threshold for approval vs. hold.
